title: DiagnosticsBundle
description:
The anonymised support bundle a user attaches to a bug report.

It is plain text so it can be pasted anywhere, and it is built only when the user asks
for it: nothing is uploaded and no telemetry is sent.

filename.description: The name a saved copy should use.

log_lines.description: Lines of application log that were included.

replacements.description: Placeholder to the original value it replaced, so the user can audit redactions.

text.description: The redacted bundle, with a heading for each section it includes.
